description:
705 of 2086 image alt-text entries in static/data/image-alt-text/en-US.json are raw Wikimedia "File:" filenames (e.g. "File:Beidou satellite mockup at FING UNLP 03.jpg") — screen-reader users hear filenames instead of descriptions. A further 1309 entries are "NASA Images search result — …" labels from the provenance title field — also not descriptive alt-text.

Expected: Every image served to users has descriptive alt-text: a non-templated sentence describing the image content, never a raw filename or internal search result label.

Acceptance criteria:
- No entry in static/data/image-alt-text/en-US.json has a value starting with "File:" or ending with a bare extension (.jpg, .png, .webp) [code-invariant: a screen reader announcing "File:something.jpg" as alt-text is a bug — the app must not do it, no spec needed]
- After rebuild, every key in static/data/image-alt-text/en-US.json has a non-empty string value [code-invariant: missing/dropped alt-text is a regression from current behavior]
- After re-localization (option B/follow-up), all 13 locale files under static/data/image-alt-text/ contain translated entries for all 2086 en-US keys (not skipping filenames) [reporter: the report states "drop the filename skip → full coverage" for the translation follow-up]
